Entry 2: Enemy Factions Part 2: Demons
These are fallen angels.
Once they were angels who loved and served our Lord Yahweh our God 
But when their leader, the Satan, convinced them that they should live for themselves, they fell from grace.
They were kicked out of heaven, and now are our greatest enemy.
They can take on any form they want, but unlike isorropians, they don't technically have a physical form and can be invisible.
They are spiritual beings that trancend us humans, but they don't trancend Yahweh our Lord our God, the only God.
Demons take up a specific amount of space at a specific time, they are not infinite. 
They are master manipulators and are the imbodiments of evil and sin.
They can possess people, and they trick people into worshipping them.
We all have to make sure not to listen to them, and to always be focused on the Lord.
We all need to resist temptations and the devil and flee from sin, just as Paul, James, and the many saints have already said.
